question: In October 2023, Maharashtra government planned which of the following schemes to overhaul its medical system after the death of 38 patients in Nanded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vision 2035**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Maharashtra government introduced the **Vision 2035** plan to modernize and revamp its healthcare system.
 
• This initiative comes in response to the tragic deaths of 38 patients in a government hospital in Nanded in October 2023.
 
• **Vision 2035** aims to upgrade medical facilities, infrastructure, and healthcare services across the state.
 
• The plan includes the integration of advanced medical technologies and training programs for healthcare professionals.
 
• The Maharashtra government is committed to ensuring better healthcare delivery and patient safety through this comprehensive scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)**

 
 
• It is a national health insurance scheme spearheaded by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
 
• It is considered to be the world's largest government-financed health assurance initiative.
 
• It aims to provide free access to health insurance coverage for India's low-income earners.
 
• AB-PMJAY provides a cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
 
• This scheme is fully financed by the Indian government, serving as a significant step towards universal healthcare in India.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)**
 
 
• It is a government-backed accident insurance scheme launched on May 9, 2015, by PM Narendra Modi.
 
• PMSBY aims to provide affordable insurance for the poor and underprivileged.
 
• Available to individuals aged 18 to 70 years with a bank account.
 
• For an annual premium of Rs.12, beneficiaries receive coverage of Rs.2 lakh for accidental death and full disability, and Rs.1 lakh for partial disability.
 
• This scheme plays a pivotal role in protecting vulnerable individuals from unforeseen risks.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)**
 
 
• Launched on May 9, 2015, by PM Narendra Modi.
 
• A government-backed life insurance scheme aimed at increasing life insurance coverage.
 
• Available to individuals aged 18 to 50 years with a bank account.
 
• Offers a life cover of Rs.2 lakhs for a one-year period, renewable annually.
 
• The annual premium is Rs.436, automatically debited from the subscriber's account.
 
• This scheme provides affordable life insurance to Indian citizens.
